founder.name: Priya Shah
founder.notes: Product manager at a mid-size logistics/software company by day; hobbyist illustrator. Ran an informal, non-app pilot (private WhatsApp group + shared Google Sheet, 14 friends from two local sketch-meetup groups, Jan 6-Feb 16 2026, 6 weeks) before any code was written. Has a freelance iOS developer informally lined up for the MVBP build, not yet under contract. Committed to a 10 hrs/week budget through the beta window alongside her full-time job (see ka-020-founder-bandwidth).

business_basics.one_liner: A daily-practice app for people trying to build a creative habit - sketching first - who keep quitting alone. Small 'circles' of real friends see your streak and nudge you back when you miss a day.
business_basics.business_type_notes: Mobile app (iOS first, Android deferred). Freemium: ad-supported free tier (sketching discipline only, banner + occasional interstitial) plus a $6.99/mo or $49.99/yr subscription (all disciplines, no ads, premium 30-day challenges, 2 streak-freeze tokens/mo) via Apple in-app purchase (App Store review requirement - cannot bill externally). Discovery via personal network, niche art/creative communities (Discord servers, r/SketchDaily), and a planned Product Hunt launch - explicitly not paid user acquisition at launch.

01_market_segmentation.summary: 13 candidate segments identified (including one explicitly rejected: sobriety/recovery journaling, on sensitivity/compliance grounds, not pursued further); 4 shortlisted for Step 2.

02_select_a_beachhead_market.summary: Beachhead selected: hobbyist sketch/drawing practitioners who've tried and abandoned a self-directed daily practice in the last 12 months - won overwhelmingly on reach and right-to-win via the founder's own community access.

03_build_an_end_user_profile.summary: End user profile drafted from 14 real pilot conversations (all within the founder's existing network - flagged as a sampling bias).

04_calculate_the_tam_for_the_beachhead_m.summary: Bottom-up beachhead TAM: naive full-conversion ceiling ~$100M/yr vs. realistic blended-ARPU figure ~$5M/yr (number of record) - this step has no consumer_app branching at all, method improvised from Step 17.

05_profile_the_persona_for_the_beachhead.summary: Persona: Maya Torres, 29, marketing coordinator - grounded in a real interviewed pilot participant.

06_full_life_cycle_use_case.summary: Full life cycle mapped across 8 stages; biggest drop-off risk: the first-60-seconds onboarding moment plus whether a circle actually forms.

07_high_level_product_specification.summary: 6 Must-have capabilities defined, traced to the FLCUC; core flow: prompt-before-signup, circle-invite immediately after first submission.

08_quantify_the_value_proposition.summary: Quantified value = ~12-day solo streak vs. 34+ day circle streak (~3x), from pilot data; gap judged directionally sufficient but confounded by self-selection.

09_identify_your_next_10_customers.summary: 8 of 10 real prospects identified with real names and access paths; beachhead accessibility: partially validated, outreach gap honestly stated.

10_define_your_core.summary: Core: not yet identified; current advantage is founder execution speed and community credibility, not a structural Core; verdict: not yet identified.

11_chart_your_competitive_position.summary: Axes: accountability structure vs. creative breadth; position: only entrant combining creative specificity with structured small-group accountability; defensibility: contestable (no Core yet).

12_determine_the_dmu.summary: DMU collapses to 1 person (end user = economic buyer); real Influencer/Recommender role; no veto-holder for the adult beachhead.

13_map_the_process_to_acquire_a_paying_c.summary: 5-stage self-serve funnel mapped (discovery through paid conversion); riskiest stage: circle formation.

14_calculate_the_tam_for_follow_on_marke.summary: Pin 2 (daily creative writers) TAM ~$3M/yr, genuinely new (not ARPU expansion); pin 3 (instrument practice) sizing deferred as a placeholder only.

15_design_a_business_model.summary: Selected model: freemium (ads + $6.99/mo or $49.99/yr subscription); one-time-IAP alternative flagged as a genuinely open, unresolved question.

16_set_your_pricing_framework.summary: Pricing metric: $6.99/mo or $49.99/yr subscription, untested with any real prospect; 4% payer-conversion and ~$0.60/yr ad-revenue assumptions both flagged low confidence.

17_calculate_the_ltv_of_a_customer.summary: Blended LTV ~$0.90/install and per-payer LTV ~$31, both derived from an unsourced category-benchmark retention curve (D1 30%/D7 12%/D30 6%/D90 4%), not 1/churn.

18_map_the_sales_process_to_acquire_a_cu.summary: Self-serve funnel costed; surfaced a real inconsistency between Step 16's flat 4% conversion assumption and this step's chained ~1.5-2% funnel-implied rate.

19_calculate_the_coca.summary: COCA ~$5/install, ~$120-130/paying user (roughly $125, re-rounded after an AI-risk BLOCKED finding for false precision); LTV:COCA ratio roughly 0.2:1 (blended) / 0.25:1 (per-payer) - both far below the 3:1 viability floor.

20_identify_key_assumptions.summary: 24 assumptions/low-confidence claims inventoried, 2 new gaps logged this sweep (App Store platform dependency, founder bandwidth); 6 ranked leap-of-faith items for Step 21.

21_test_key_assumptions.summary: 6 shortlisted assumptions given full test designs (5 deferred pending the MVBP beta, 1 - founder bandwidth - accepted/validated by explicit founder commitment); every other inventory item given a recorded disposition, none left blank.

22_define_the_mvbp.summary: MVBP: 150-person closed iOS beta, real Apple in-app purchase at the real price, manual pod-matching, prompt-before-signup first-60-seconds flow; designed to prove conversion, circle-formation, and retention.

23_show_that_dogs_will_eat_the_dog_food.summary: Not yet measurable - no MVBP has launched; the informal pilot's data is suggestive context but explicitly not treated as dog-food evidence.

24_develop_a_product_plan.summary: Near-term roadmap: launch the beta, instrument retention/circle-formation, resolve 2 cheap pre-launch assumptions; explicitly no paid UA spend and no pin-2 work until beta retention is observed stable.

Step 4 (plan/04-calculate-the-tam-for-the-beachhead-market.md): the ~13M reference population underlying the beachhead TAM is a founder gut estimate with no external source; recommend sourcing it externally before this figure is presented to any outside party (advisory, not blocking - both TAM figures are otherwise honestly rounded and sourced as unvalidated estimates).

Step 19 (plan/19-calculate-the-coca.md): qc-019-coca-payer was originally stated as an exact '$125.00' despite being built from two confidence:low inputs (ka-019-founder-rate, ka-019-install-estimate) chained through division - false precision, the same failure mode independently caught in round 2 (Step 17 LTV), round 3 (Step 4 TAM, Step 17 LTV), and round 4 (Step 19 COCA). Resolved by restating as a range ('~$120-130, roughly $125') and re-rounding the LTV:COCA ratio and payback period; re-run of the gate confirmed the fix.
